elsewhere.note: They, when they heard it, were glad, and promised to give him money. He sought how he might conveniently deliver him.
He gave him no inheritance in it, no, not so much as to set his foot on. He promised that he would give it to him for a possession, and to his offspring after…
and being fully assured that what he had promised, he was also able to perform.
Then why is there the law? It was added because of transgressions, until the offspring should come to whom the promise has been made. It was ordained through…
but with good works, which is appropriate for women professing godliness.
in hope of eternal life, which God, who can’t lie, promised before time began;
For when God made a promise to Abraham, since he could swear by no one greater, he swore by himself,
Blessed is a person who endures temptation, for when he has been approved, he will receive the crown of life, which the Lord promised to those who love him.
